plain: hey so u gotta pay by friday ok
legal: The Client shall make payment no later than Friday.

plain: pls dont park in front of the garage!!
legal: Parking in front of the garage is prohibited.

plain: if ur late more than 15 min we start without u
legal: If a participant arrives more than fifteen (15) minutes late, the session shall commence without that participant.

plain: no refunds sorry
legal: No refunds shall be issued.

plain: gonna need the files back by tmrw
legal: The Recipient shall return the files by tomorrow.

plain: rent's 1200, due on the 1st, no excuses
legal: The rent of $1200 shall be due on the first (1st) day of each month without exception.

plain: u break it u buy it
legal: Any person who damages an item shall be liable to pay for it.

plain: kids eat free on tuesdays (under 10)
legal: Children under the age of ten (10) shall eat free of charge on Tuesdays.

plain: ok so basically we split everything down the middle
legal: All costs and proceeds shall be shared equally between the Parties.

plain: Just FYI — we're closing the account if it stays unpaid past the 20th.
legal: The account shall be closed if it remains unpaid after the twentieth (20th) day of the month.

plain: don't tell anyone about the new product til launch day
legal: No information concerning the new product shall be disclosed to any person prior to the launch date.

plain: dogs ok, cats no
legal: Dogs shall be permitted on the Premises; cats shall not be permitted.

plain: wifi password is for guests only, don't post it anywhere
legal: The wireless network password is provided for the use of guests only and shall not be published in any medium.

plain: if the shipment's late again we're done with them
legal: If any further shipment is delivered late, the Company shall terminate its relationship with the Supplier.

plain: the deposit's yours back if nothing's broken
legal: The deposit shall be returned in full provided that no damage has occurred.

plain: Can't make it? Let us know 48 hrs before.
legal: Any attendee who is unable to attend shall notify the Organizer not less than forty-eight (48) hours in advance.

plain: we'll cover flights, u cover hotel
legal: The Company shall bear the cost of flights, and the Consultant shall bear the cost of accommodation.

plain: lmk by eod if ur in or out
legal: Each participant shall confirm by the end of the day whether the participant intends to participate.

plain: max 2 tickets per person, no exceptions
legal: Each person may purchase a maximum of two (2) tickets, without exception.

plain: return the keys when ur done w/ the van
legal: The Hirer shall return the keys upon completion of the use of the van.

plain: payment = 50% now, 50% when done
legal: Fifty percent (50%) of the fee shall be payable upon signing, and the remaining fifty percent (50%) shall be payable upon completion.

plain: no outside food plz
legal: Outside food is not permitted.

plain: we're not paying for stuff we didn't order
legal: The Company shall not pay for any goods that it did not order.

plain: if u wanna cancel, do it before the 15th or u still pay for the month
legal: Any cancellation shall be made before the fifteenth (15th) day of the month, failing which the fee for that month shall remain payable.

plain: Heads up: price goes up 10% next yr.
legal: The price shall increase by 10% with effect from the following year.

plain: only managers can approve overtime
legal: Overtime may be approved only by managers.

plain: keep the noise down after 10, neighbors complained
legal: Noise shall be kept to a minimum after 10 pm.

plain: whoever finishes the coffee makes a new pot
legal: The person who empties the coffee pot shall prepare a fresh pot.

plain: bring ur own helmet, we don't lend them
legal: Participants shall bring their own helmets, as helmets shall not be provided on loan.

plain: deadline's the 30th, after that we can't accept anything
legal: The deadline shall be the thirtieth (30th) day of the month, and no submissions shall be accepted thereafter.

plain: if the client says no, the deal's off
legal: If the Client withholds approval, the transaction shall not proceed.

plain: we pay the 1st and 15th of each month
legal: Payments shall be made on the first (1st) and fifteenth (15th) days of each month.

plain: if u see something weird on the server, tell IT asap
legal: Any irregular activity observed on the server shall be reported to the IT department as soon as possible.

plain: 3 strikes and ur out of the league
legal: Any player who receives three (3) violations shall be expelled from the League.

plain: we'll throw in free shipping if u order 2 or more
legal: Free shipping shall be provided on orders of two (2) or more items.

plain: plz sign + return by next wed
legal: The signed document shall be returned no later than Wednesday of next week.

plain: ur free to quit anytime, just give 2 weeks
legal: The Employee may resign at any time upon giving two (2) weeks' notice.

plain: the boat's mine, u can use it on weekends if u fill the tank
legal: The Owner permits the other Party to use the Boat on weekends, provided that the other Party refuels it after each use.

plain: don't use the company card for personal stuff, seriously
legal: The Company credit card shall not be used for personal purposes under any circumstances.

plain: anyone who lies on the form gets disqualified
legal: Any applicant who provides false information on the form shall be disqualified.
